description: Returns submissions newest first as a cursor-paginated page. Filter by `form` name, `status` (`inbox` by default, or `spam`), and `source` (`published` for real visitors, `draft` for test submissions from the draft preview). Items carry the fields in submitted order, the inferred submitter email and name, page, spam signals, classifier verdict, and notification state. Submission data is personal information: never render it on the public website.

form.description: Only submissions of this form name.

source.description: `published` for real visitors, `draft` for test submissions from the draft preview.

name: websiteForms_submissions_list
title: List form submissions
